overall_rating.summary_label: Minor edge coverage loss, interference-limited handover for 88% of area

constraint_check.C3_note: TRIGGERED — dominant_area_impact_regime=mostly_mild; preprocessing dominant_area_mild_fraction=1.0 and dominant_area_severe_fraction=0.0 are unambiguous. Base Level 2 (holes 5-20%) reduced one level to Level 1
constraint_check.C5_note: NOT triggered — nsa_5g_downgrade_risk.flagged=false; primary backup USID_27 has 8 5G cells

most_affected_zones.location: S/SW edge, outer boundary of USID_00 dominance area

main_reasons: Coverage hole fraction = 11.54% (3 of 26 dominant pixels): S/SW residential fringe has no backup handover target — complete signal loss for the full 4-hour morning window.

C3 applied (dominant_area_mild_fraction=1.0): interference_limited regime confirmed by three-signal method for both covered zones (USID_27 easy_gap=0.5625, USID_29 easy_gap=0.6364; RULE 2 fires) — backups were already competitive pre-outage, reducing practical impact for 88.46% of users. Severity reduced from moderate (Level 2) to low (Level 1).
All five backup USIDs post_outage_load_factor ≤ 0.013 — zero capacity stress; load redistribution is adequate.
Shutdown duration 4.0 hours (08:00–12:00): sustained window covering the morning traffic peak — all users in the dominant area are affected for the full period.
mitigating_factors: Interference_limited sinr_regime across 88.46% of the area (RULE 2 confirmed): backups were already strong before the outage — gap between USID_00 and backups is small (easy_gap dominant for primary backups).
All in-zone RSRP values ≥ -58.83 dBm (strong) across all covered pixels — handover quality excellent throughout.
No capacity overload: max post_outage_load_factor = 0.013, over 30× below the medium-risk threshold.
No critical infrastructure at risk — C2 not triggered; no hospital, no major expressway in the target area.
Primary backup USID_27 has 8 5G cells (exceeds USID_00's 6) — 5G continuity maintained on the primary handover path.
final_conclusion: The USID_00 shutdown from 08:00 to 12:00 on 2024-03-15 is a low-severity, Level 1 (Minimal) impact event after applying C3 for the fully interference-limited dominant area (dominant_area_mild_fraction=1.0). The three-signal sinr_regime analysis confirms RULE 2 (interference_limited) for 88.46% of the target area — primary backups USID_27 and USID_29 have easy_gap dominance (replaceability=easy), a good signal environment, and low SINR, meaning the shutdown causes no surprising quality drop for the majority of users. The only material impact is the 11.54% S/SW residential coverage hole (3 pixels) with no handover target for the sustained 4-hour window. No critical infrastructure is affected, no backup site will experience capacity stress, and 5G continuity is preserved on all primary handover paths. The outage is operationally low-risk with the S/SW fringe hole as the sole zone warranting attention.
